verdict.rationale: Community Phone offers some fixed, event-triggered telephony rules. Unanswered calls can roll to other numbers or ring several at once, and admins can set call routing, forwarding, dial menus and who-can-call allow-lists. Users can also schedule automated check-in or reminder calls and get missed-call alerts. These are preset call-handling options, not a general rule engine where users define their own triggers and actions, and probes found no API to build such automation. Missing for 10: user-defined trigger/condition/action rules, events beyond call handling, programmatic or API-driven automation, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
